words.def: the things that belong to you
a group of similar things that one person has gathered over time
an object that is old and valuable because of its age
so important that you cannot manage without it
right for a particular person, purpose or occasion
popular and modern at this moment
the state something is in — how good or how damaged it is

a strong material made from animal skin

with a bright surface that reflects the light

light in colour, not strong or bright
weighing a lot, so that it is difficult to lift
with a small distance between one side and the other

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
My favourite possession is a ring.

a / an — you mention it for the first time. The listener does not know it yet.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
The ring was my grandmother’s.

the — second mention. Now we both know which ring.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
It’s got a dark blue stone with a black spot on it.

Two new things, so a twice. Not the — you have not heard about them before.

steps.title: Why is it a ring in the first sentence and the ring in the second?
options: because the second sentence is in the past
because by the second sentence we both know which ring
because ring is a special kind of noun
steps.answer: because by the second sentence we both know which ring

items: introduce something new — It’s a ring / an antique box
talk about it again — The ring was my grandmother’s
talk about things in general — I love antique jewellery, made of leather
